name: Croix Eden
source:
The first princess of the Kingdom of Eden and [url=https://vndb.org/c31029]Riche[/url]'s elder sister. She is also a Saint of the Church of Mother Eve. 

She is betrothed to [url=https://vndb.org/c72206]Felton[/url], the prince of Central Empire.
